listen.law: SOURCE → ADDRESS → APERTURE → PROJECTION → ANNOTATION → RETURN

research_signal.conclusion: RSVP should remain a bounded throughput/attention mode with cheap regression/review, not a universal replacement for ordinary reading.

deep_conclusions: READFIELD is best understood as an addressed attention/work transform, not primarily a speed-reader.
Phone work should be serial: HELD OBJECT → JOB → 1–3 OPERATIONS → VISIBLE CONSEQUENCE → WITNESS → RETURN.
A mechanism that cannot currently produce consequence must expose the missing condition instead of appearing inert.
FAST → friction → REVIEW → resolve → FAST is the primary RSVP work loop; regression is a comprehension mechanism, not an exception.
Marks are addressed re-entry evidence, not a new note-taking authority.
LISTEN and READFIELD are sibling addressed-source hosts: audio uses temporal apertures; text uses semantic/structural apertures.
Borrowed clock != borrowed authorship remains the correct cross-surface law.
Cross-app integration should appear as verbs/recipes (READ LYRICS, READ → LOCI, TEMPO, NEXT MARK, RETURN), not integration settings.
